title: Cartesian-edge transitivity for two inner fibrations
statement: Use quasicategories and simplicial maps of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and inner fibrations and cartesian edges of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $A,D,B$ be quasicategories in a fixed universe, let $a:A\to D$ and $b:D\to B$ be inner fibrations, and let $h:u\to v$ be an edge of $A$. Suppose $a(h)$ is $b$-cartesian. Then $h$ is $a$-cartesian if and only if it is $(b\circ a)$-cartesian.
